provenance.note: Location-only numeric init retains location coefficients and appends scales from R's 20-iteration intercept-only fit using weights, offsets, censoring, and scale strata. Numeric init bypasses covariate rescaling. Every accepted partial reference is checked against its expanded full init. Native flags are observed without modifying R fits. Mean-only partial starts fail in R 3.8-11; full-start controls remain valid.
